_about: Copy to watch.json and edit. repo: your repo. identities: who counts as 'ours' for the auto-merge gate; remap_owners.py fills identities.ours from github_login in workplace.local.json, the login the poll loop also uses. prs/issues: what to watch, keyed by number; owner is {"session": ..., "terminal": ...} or null for report-only. Your own open PRs that are missing here show up as unwatched_open_prs. See KIT/rules/watcher.md.
